summary: Iteration 38 — Licensing + Support + Marketplace V2 + Security helpers tested. Backend 22/22 pytest pass (4 regression + 7 licensing + 7 support + 4 marketplace_v2). All NEW endpoints behave per contract: /api/licensing/plans returns 4 XAF-priced plans, /subscribe?free → instant active license, /subscribe?premium_farmer monthly→amount=15000 / annual→amount=120000, /admin/all gates non-admin to 403. Support: 8 categories + 4 priorities, ticket creation returns TK-yymmdd-XXXXXX number, <3-char subject → 422, admin reply auto-flips status to in_progress, /admin/tickets returns full stats dict, rate_limit triggers 429 after 5 calls/hour. Marketplace V2: /purchase/initiate returns confirmation_required + summary, replay nonce → 409, /purchase/confirm with confirmed=false → cancelled. NO REGRESSION on existing /api/dashboard/stats, /api/parcels, /api/payments/packages, /api/admin/analytics-presentation. Frontend: /licences page renders all 4 plan cards (data-testid plan-free/premium_farmer/cooperative/enterprise) with Mensuel/Annuel toggle, Activer on free succeeds (current plan badge updates). /support page renders ticket list with TK- numbers + status badges; previously-created ticket from backend tests shows 'En cours' status (proves admin-reply-triggers-status-change flow end-to-end through DB).

minor.issue: In-memory rate limiter keyed on request.client.host can be partially bypassed when multiple ingress proxy IPs fan-out requests to the same backend pod. Verified manually that limiter triggers correctly for rapid back-to-back calls from a single connection (1 success then 7×429). For production hardening, key on X-Forwarded-For (real client IP) or move bucket to Redis.

Reads product from db.marketplace_products / db.products, but the existing /api/marketplace/products endpoint returns 2 hardcoded mock products (prod1/prod2) that are NOT in MongoDB and use 'price_per_unit' field instead of 'price'/'unit_price'. Result: real users browsing the legacy marketplace cannot purchase via marketplace-v2 — initiate returns 404 ('Produit introuvable') or 400 ('Prix produit invalide'). Either (a) seed marketplace_products collection from the hardcoded list, (b) make initiate fall back to read from the in-memory list used by /api/marketplace/products, or (c) extend price extraction to also accept 'price_per_unit'.

ui_bugs.issue: Same as iter 37 — the 7-step Dashboard tour auto-opens on EVERY route mount (including /licences and /support) and intercepts clicks on the 'Nouveau ticket' (data-testid='create-ticket-btn') button, preventing the create-ticket dialog from opening in fresh sessions. Setting localStorage flags didn't dismiss it. Must be skipped via the X button manually before users can interact with primary CTAs.

issues: Premium Agriculteur card already shows 'Actuel' badge after ANY pending subscription was created — it should only mark the plan whose license is in 'active' status, not 'pending'. Currently a user who clicks 'S’abonner' but never pays will still see 'Actuel' on the paid card.
Ticket list rows have low contrast (light-grey-on-near-black). Subject text 'TEST_rl_2_5ca7' is barely readable. Bump foreground contrast for ticket subjects (currently ~AA-fail at WCAG).

action_items: MUST FIX (HIGH): Disable / auto-dismiss GuidedTour on /licences, /support, /admin-support routes (or once user has visited dashboard). Currently it blocks the create-ticket flow.

SHOULD FIX: Marketplace V2 product lookup — the legacy /api/marketplace/products returns hardcoded mocks not in DB; either persist them on startup or make /api/marketplace-v2/purchase/initiate read from the same source. Otherwise the popup feature is unreachable from the UI.
SHOULD FIX: 'Actuel' badge on /licences should require status='active', not just any license existing for the plan_id.
NICE TO HAVE: Move rate-limit bucket key to X-Forwarded-For header (or Redis) to be reliable behind multi-replica ingress.
NICE TO HAVE: Improve contrast on /support ticket list rows for WCAG-AA compliance.
critical_code_review_comments: security_helpers.py is clean and well-structured (sliding-window rate limit + nonce TTL purge + magic-bytes file validator + HTML/regex sanitizer). One concern: _rate_buckets and _seen_nonces are in-process dicts — won't survive backend restarts and don't share across workers. Document that or move to Redis for prod.

licensing.py / support.py / marketplace_v2.py all duplicate the same 12-line _user_from_request JWT helper. Consider extracting into routes/_auth.py to follow DRY and avoid drift if JWT_SECRET_KEY env var changes.
marketplace_v2.initiate_purchase reads only 'price' and 'unit_price' fields, but legacy products use 'price_per_unit'. Add fallback OR document required schema.

support.py admin_set_status uses a query parameter `status: str` instead of a Pydantic body model — easy to misuse (any string accepted before the in-block validation). Switch to Pydantic Literal for cleaner OpenAPI docs.

license activation endpoint (/api/licensing/activate/{license_id}) is exposed to the user themselves — they can call it directly without payment. Should be limited to webhook secret + admin role. Currently the user can self-activate any pending license.
All Mongo reads correctly project out _id with {'_id': 0} — no ObjectId leakage.

Pydantic models on TicketCreate / PurchaseInitiate enforce min_length and regex patterns — good validation hygiene. PurchaseInitiate.nonce min 8 chars is OK but should add a server-side check that nonce is hex/url-safe to prevent injection of weird unicode.

Two real bugs found and reported (above). The same GuidedTour overlay issue from iter 37 still blocks /support primary CTA — main agent should disable the tour on non-dashboard routes. rca of the issue: Marketplace V2 'Prix produit invalide' RCA: legacy /api/marketplace/products serves 2 hardcoded products from in-code list — they are NEVER inserted into MongoDB. The new /api/marketplace-v2/purchase/initiate reads via _db.marketplace_products.find_one(...) and falls back to _db.products.find_one(...) — both return None for the legacy mocks. Even if found, the code reads product['price'] or product['unit_price'], but legacy mocks only have 'price_per_unit'. Fix path: (a) on backend startup, upsert the hardcoded list into _db.marketplace_products with normalized 'price' field; or (b) change marketplace_v2 to delegate product lookup to the same source as /api/marketplace/products. GuidedTour blocking /support 'Nouveau ticket' RCA: GuidedTour component mounts globally and renders a fixed-position overlay that wins z-index over the page-level dialog trigger; clicking 'Nouveau ticket' fires the React handler but the dialog opens behind the tour, OR the tour's full-screen overlay blocks the click entirely (we verified the dialog never appears in DOM). Fix path: gate GuidedTour render on currentRoute === '/dashboard' or check a route allowlist.
